# Fly Homes

> > Global student accommodation booking platform connecting international students with housing across 250+ cities worldwide.

Fly Homes specializes in student housing solutions for international students studying abroad, offering property bookings alongside essential ancillary services like airport transfers, SIM cards, and starter kits. The platform serves students in major university cities including Nottingham, Birmingham, Glasgow, and Dublin.

## Key Topics

- student accommodation
- international students
- study abroad housing
- university housing
- property booking
- ancillary services

- SIM cards
- rental properties

- global student housing
- Leamigo
- 250+ cities worldwide

## Core Services

- [Book Student Accommodation That Best Suits You | Fly Homes](https://fly.homes): Homepage for student accommodation booking across 250+ cities worldwide
- [Ancillary Services](https://fly.homes/ancilaries): Student services including airport transfers, SIM cards, and starter kits
